what_happened: Re-measuring shellcheck -S warning against the source store (agent-system/extensions/, 359 scripts) reproduced the dispatch's 2026-10-09 deployed-tree counts closely (196 findings/82 files vs. the dispatch's ~180/~85), including an exact match on the named SC2066 single-pass-loop sites, the 2 session_id SC2154 sites, and both SC2319 sites -- high confidence the fix list in the dispatch is accurate and current.

Research report's live measurement reproduced exactly at plan time: shellcheck -x -S warning over git ls-files 'agent-system/extensions/*.sh' gives 196 findings across 82 of 359 files, with an identical per-code histogram. No re-derivation needed; the plan's counts are confirmed, not carried.

Research report's recommendations omit manifest registration. core/manifest.json's provides.scripts array lists every lint script and its fixture test (e.g. 'lint/lint-state-writer-boundary.sh', 'tests/test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh'), so the new lint-shellcheck.sh and test-lint-shellcheck.sh must each be added there or they never deploy into .claude/. Plan adds explicit manifest steps to Phases 1, 2, and 7.

Research recommended resolving the lint's file set via 'git ls-files' only, but the fixture test the acceptance criterion requires writes synthetic scripts to a mktemp -d workdir that is not a git work tree, so git ls-files cannot see them. Resolved in the plan by mirroring lint-state-writer-boundary.sh's existing positional scan-path contract: no argument = git ls-files over the source store; an explicit path argument = find over that path.

Research report says two '1-21' range literals in verify-deploy.sh must be bumped (lines 119, 125). There are four (two header-comment occurrences at lines 80 and 86 plus the two error strings) and additionally a stale inline comment reading 'in 1..20' that was already out of date before this task. Plan's Phase 7 targets all five sites via grep rather than a line list.

ROADMAP lists task 318 as 'ready': 'Wire lint-directory-pathspec-boundary.sh into verify-deploy.sh as a numbered gate'. Both tasks would claim gate 22 and both must bump the same --only-gate range literals in verify-deploy.sh. Plan records this as a risk and makes the gate number a Scope Hypothesis to confirm at implementation time rather than a hardcoded 22.

Plan passed scripts/validate-artifact.sh in --strict mode with 0 warnings on the first run, and check-task-references.sh with 0 occurrences. The plan-format-enforcement rule's sanctioned-entry-point clause (name the repo's entry point, not the bare binary, and check exit status) caught a real sequencing defect in the first draft: Phases 1 and 3 were placed in the same wave, which would have left every fix phase with no sanctioned verifier. Making Phase 3 depend on Phase 1 fixed both the compliance issue and the underlying logic.

Phase 3's _p SC2154 site (test-lean-mcp-preflight-check.sh) was not a simple triage-and-disable case as the plan anticipated: shellcheck cannot track a for-loop variable bound entirely inside a single-quoted inline trap string, producing a false SC2154 on the trap's own loop var. Fixed by refactoring to a named cleanup() function + 'trap cleanup EXIT' (ordinary script-level code shellcheck can see), rather than an inline disable, which also improved style.

Full run-all.sh --jobs auto sweep after Phase 3 showed 2 failing suites (test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh, test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh), neither touched by this task (git diff HEAD confirms zero change to either file or its lint/gate target). test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh passes cleanly (8/8) when run alone, confirming its failure under --jobs auto was a parallel-execution flake. test-verify-deploy-context-budget.sh still fails its 'baseline fixture is not clean' case even run alone/sequentially -- a pre-existing environmental condition in this live dev tree (byte-ceiling drift unrelated to shellcheck), not a regression introduced by this task. Neither blocks Phase 3 closure.

SC2034 triage in skill-base.sh surfaced two vestigial-but-still-actively-passed parameters: skill_link_artifacts's field_name/next_field (5th/6th args, historical TODO.md-direct-edit insertion-position controls from before the state.json+generate-todo.sh redesign) and skill_corroborate_phase_counts's handoff_path (4th arg, historical handoff-content corroboration source). Both are still passed positionally by live callers and fixture tests (docs/examples/research-flow-example.md, orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh, multiple SKILL.md files) but are read nowhere in either function body today -- confirmed by full-function grep. Kept (disabled, not deleted) per this task's own scope and the plan's 'lifecycle contract, prefer disables' guidance for this file; flagged here as a candidate for a future cleanup task to either wire them up or drop the dead positional slots across all callers.

SC2034 triage in update-task-status.sh surfaced TODO_STATUS: computed in lockstep with STATE_STATUS at ~13 assignment sites throughout the script (map_status's case arms, the unhold branch, the hold-notice branch) but read nowhere in this file or any other file in the tree (confirmed by grep -rl). TODO.md's own status display text is derived directly from state.json's status field by generate-todo.sh today, making the whole TODO_STATUS side of the pairing vestigial. Only the one shellcheck-flagged occurrence (the hold-notice branch) was disabled in this task, per its minimal-footprint fix policy; the other ~12 unflagged sites were left untouched. Flagged here as a candidate for a future cleanup task to remove the TODO_STATUS computation entirely.

Phase 5's verification text calls for a full verify-deploy.sh pass, but that gate's own Gate 5 (manifest-driven content-hash equality) necessarily fails until the deployed .claude/ tree is refreshed from the source store -- which is Phase 7's own redeploy step, by design (the plan's Rollback/Contingency section explicitly accepts this: whole-tree lint zero-findings is reached at Phase 6, full verify-deploy.sh green only after Phase 7's redeploy). Ran it anyway to confirm the failure shape is exactly content-drift (13 findings, all 'Content differs from source' or 'Missing scripts' for files this task has touched/added) and not a new, unrelated regression; Gate 8's full run-all.sh battery also exceeded a 590s bounded wait and was not completed in this attempt. Deferred the full verify-deploy.sh green confirmation to Phase 7 as the plan's own sequencing intends; Phase 5 closure here rests on the shellcheck lint itself (0 findings) plus every individually-touched suite's own green run.
